module AbortPropagationOk

error NotFound

function read(id: Integer) returns Integer
aborts NotFound when id = 0
is
    if id = 0 then
        abort NotFound
    end if

    return id
end read

function load(id: Integer) returns Integer
aborts NotFound when id = 0
is
    return read(id)
end load

end AbortPropagationOk
